newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia raises penalty for spousal sex abuse.
newsitem.headline: Colombia raises penalty for spousal sex abuse.

text.p: Colombia's Constitutional Court has increased the penalty for violent sexual abuse among spouses to a maximum of eight years in prison, Bogota's El Tiempo newspaper reported on Friday.
Court officials could not immediately be reached for comment on the ruling, which the newspaper said was handed down on Thursday.
El Tiempo said the previous penalty for rape or other forms of violent sexual abuse among married couples or "permanent companions" ranged from six months to two years' imprisonment.

According to a recent study by a presidential office for the defence of women's rights, 44 percent of Colombian women who have been the victim of some form of sexual abuse blamed the attacks on their husbands or boyfriends.
